plugins.name: kaying-for-ui
plugins.description: Game UI design and handoff workflow: from planning GDD/PRD/interaction logic to design specs, screen extension, visual generation, component breakdown, sprite slicing, atlas, and Godot/Unity/Cocos engine JSON handoff, with a reproducible contract, validation, and packaging toolchain.

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: 游戏界面设计UI设计-咖影

description_i18n.zh-CN: 游戏界面设计UI设计-咖影：把游戏概念或参考图变成可复现的多屏 UI 工程——GDD/PRD/交互、设计令牌、界面延展、页面视觉、组件拆解、雪碧图切图、图集打包，直至 Godot/Unity/Cocos 引擎 JSON 交付。
description_i18n.en-US: Turn a game concept or reference into a reproducible multi-screen UI project: GDD/PRD/interaction, design tokens, screen extension, page visuals, component breakdown, sprite splitting, atlas packing, and engine JSON handoff.

examplePrompts: Use kaying-for-ui to build a complete UI project for a Chinese-style card RPG from reference images: finish planning and design specs first, then generate the home screen visual
Split this home screen into transparent-background components, then slice the sprite sheet into individual PNGs and pack them
Generate 9-slice, atlas, and Unity/Godot handoff JSON

zh-CN: 用咖影根据参考图为一个国风卡牌 RPG 搭建完整 UI 项目：先完成策划与设计规格，再生成主界面视觉
把这张主界面拆成透明底组件，然后切雪碧图为单张 PNG 并打包图集
生成 9-slice、图集与 Unity/Godot 交付 JSON
